item.title: Wood stove experiment reveals how wildfire smoke helps sunlight regenerate nitrogen oxides
item.description: Wildfires bring to mind a blazing sea of flames. But what happens to the smoke? Anyone observing a wildfire from a safe distance notices mainly the enormous clouds that tower above the fire. These rise several kilometers and then embark on journeys that can extend across continents and oceans. Pollutants from wildfires in Canada can still be detected, for example, at the Jungfraujoch in the Swiss Alps. Fuente: Phys.org.

Nacido en Taiwán y trasladado a Estados Unidos en su infancia, el fundador y CEO de NVIDIA transformó una pequeña empresa creada en 1993 en uno de los gigantes mundiales de los semiconductores y la inteligencia artificial. Su trayectoria refleja el auge de la computación, los videojuegos, la informática móvil y la IA. Sin embargo, su figura ahora se rodea de controversias por una presunta relación extramatrimonial con una ciudadana china acusada de espionaje, esto en medio de la creciente rivalidad tecnológica… Publicado también por: France 24 - Español. Fuente: La Nación - El Mundo.

item.description: The resignation of Nvidia founder Jensen Huang has thrown one of the world's most iconic technology companies into a leadership crisis, whose ripple effects extend far beyond Silicon Valley. Nvidia occupies a unique position in a booming AI industruy marked by intensifying competition between the United States and China. Its leadership upheaval raises immediate questions about corporate succession. But it is also fueling a broader debate about economic resilience, national security and the political influence of big tech titans.
